review_candidates.description: Project Manager – Event Design & Decor Execution Location: Gurugram, Haryana, India Experience: 4–6 years About the Company A confidential organization creating distinctive visual environments and bespoke experiences for weddings, galas, private celebrations, corporate functions, and product launches. The team transforms creative ideas into polished event experiences through thoughtful design, precise production, and disciplined execution. Its work spans concept development, decor fabrication, vendor coordination, logistics, installation, and event-site delivery, with every element expected to meet high standards of quality and presentation. The organization values creativity, excellence, attention to detail, professionalism, precision, and mastery of event protocol. It serves sophisticated clients who expect memorable experiences, reliable delivery, and careful management of complex requirements. The team is focused on building a strong operational engine that allows creative ambition to translate into seamless, high-impact events across locations. This is an opportunity to join a hands-on environment where ownership, judgment, collaboration, and practical problem-solving directly shape the quality of every project delivered. About the Role Own the end-to-end delivery of event design and decor projects, translating creative briefs into executable plans, controlled production, and flawless on-site outcomes. You will connect design, fabrication, vendors, logistics, clients, and installation teams so every element is delivered to specification, on time, within agreed budgets, and in line with venue and safety requirements. The role combines planning discipline with creative judgment and requires regular workshop checks, client meetings, site visits, pre-event reviews, installations, and dismantling. Based in Gurugram, you will work full-time with Sunday as the weekly day off and other Saturdays generally working. Standard timings are 9:00 AM to 7:30 PM Dubai time, with occasional extended hours during event builds or urgent project phases. Additional hours or weekend work will be managed through compensatory time or schedule adjustments according to company policy. Key Responsibilities Convert creative briefs into practical decor execution plans, production schedules, resource lists, installation timelines, and clear deliverables that keep design, production, and logistics teams aligned. Own vendor, fabricator, and supplier coordination by sourcing capable partners, negotiating requirements, tracking procurement, and securing reliable delivery of materials, props, and finished decor elements. Maintain an accurate vendor tracker covering quality, pricing, capacity, and reliability so project decisions improve supplier performance, reduce execution risk, and support consistent delivery standards. Control production progress through workshop visits, quality checks, pre-event meetings, issue resolution, and specification reviews that protect creative intent, safety, timelines, and client expectations. Lead venue installation and dismantling, allocate manpower and resources, and resolve last-minute site challenges so event spaces are completed safely, professionally, and ready for successful delivery. Serve as the decor execution contact for clients and internal stakeholders, contributing technical input during meetings and site visits while ensuring agreed standards, budgets, and approvals remain controlled. Maintain complete project records, including budgets, contracts, design approvals, schedules, and compliance documentation, while supporting the vetting of new vendors and freelance execution partners. Essential Skills & Technologies Demonstrated project management capability across event design and decor execution, with the judgment to convert creative direction into controlled plans, production milestones, and measurable delivery outcomes. Strong vendor and production management skills, including sourcing, negotiation, procurement coordination, workshop quality checks, material knowledge, fabrication awareness, and supplier performance tracking. Practical on-site execution expertise, including installation, dismantling, manpower allocation, venue coordination, safety compliance, and calm resolution of urgent or changing event requirements. Clear communication and stakeholder coordination skills for working with clients, designers, production teams, logistics partners, fabricators, freelancers, and diverse on-ground crews. Proficiency with Excel, Google Sheets, Asana, Trello, Monday.com, Google Drive, SharePoint, OneDrive, Google Calendar, Outlook, Canva, PowerPoint, or Adobe Acrobat for planning and documentation. Strong attention to detail, creative problem-solving ability, and the resilience to manage multiple vendors, deadlines, approvals, and project priorities during high-pressure event periods. Additional Plus Experience delivering premium client events, high-profile celebrations, corporate functions, product launches, weddings, galas, or other complex bespoke experiences is advantageous. A strong portfolio demonstrating successful event decor projects, practical design understanding, and consistent control of production quality will be valued. Experience with leading event design and decor agencies or comparable high-volume production environments will be considered an advantage. What You'll Bring 4–6 years of project management experience focused on event design, decor production, fabrication, or on-ground event execution, supported by examples of work delivered from brief through installation. A Bachelor's degree in Event Management, Design, Architecture, or a related discipline is preferred; equivalent hands-on experience with a strong portfolio will also be considered. You bring structured planning, commercial awareness, supplier judgment, and a sharp eye for detail, enabling creative concepts to become practical, safe, high-quality environments within agreed budgets and timelines. You communicate confidently with premium clients, vendors, fabricators, designers, logistics teams, and site crews, while remaining composed when requirements shift or execution pressure increases. You are comfortable working from Gurugram, attending workshops, client meetings, and site visits, and taking ownership of installations, dismantling, documentation, and delivery-critical decisions. You are willing to work extended hours during event builds or urgent project phases, with additional hours or weekend work offset through compensatory time or schedule adjustments under company policy. Why Join Us Own work that is visible, tangible, and commercially important, with direct responsibility for turning ambitious creative concepts into memorable environments that clients and guests experience firsthand. Work across the full event delivery chain, from creative interpretation and supplier selection through fabrication, quality control, installation, and dismantling, building deep expertise in bespoke event execution. Join a hands-on team that values creativity, excellence, precision, professionalism, and attention to detail, where strong operational judgment directly improves the quality and reliability of every event. Self-motivated candidates will find meaningful opportunities to grow by taking ownership of increasingly complex projects, strengthening client and vendor relationships, and expanding their influence across the event delivery operation. Develop relationships with designers, fabricators, vendors, clients, and event professionals while managing varied projects across weddings, galas, celebrations, corporate functions, and product launches. Receive competitive compensation and a practical working arrangement that recognizes additional event-period demands through compensatory time or schedule adjustments in line with company policy. What We Offer Competitive compensation aligned with the scope of ownership, event execution expertise, portfolio quality, and experience managing complex decor projects. Full-time ownership of varied event design and decor assignments, with exposure to creative planning, vendor ecosystems, fabrication, client coordination, and large-scale on-ground delivery. A structured working arrangement with Sunday as the weekly day off, while additional event-period hours are managed through compensatory time or schedule adjustments under company policy.

Previous experience working on Oracle HCM Cloud implementations or transformation programmes.

review_candidates.description: Join Axon and be a Force for Good. At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other. Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter. Marketing Manager, Northern Europe Join Axon and be a Force for Good At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We partner with our customers on some of society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. We’re out to make the world a safer place by solving big problems and taking on the public safety challenges of our time. From our company's inception building the TASER device to a full suite of hardware and software solutions, we are focused on providing police agencies with state-of-the-art devices and services they need to successfully serve and protect. Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter. Your Impact This role offers a unique opportunity to join a dynamic team where your contributions will drive tangible, meaningful results for the business and the communities we serve in Northern Europe (Benelux and Nordics). You'll have the agility of working within a small, in-region sales and marketing team while benefiting from the resources and backing of a profitable, publicly traded company. As part of Axon’s centralized marketing function, you’ll collaborate closely across regions and departments to ensure consistent, high-impact initiatives. As the Marketing Manager, Northern Europe, you will be a key player on our Global Marketing team, focused on providing life-saving solutions to public safety and security agencies worldwide. You’ll see firsthand the impact of your work, hearing directly from customers how our products help save lives. The better we do our jobs, the more lives we protect and the greater the positive impact we make on global communities. What You’ll Do Location: Amsterdam (Work remotely Monday, and in the office Tues-Fri) Reports to: Vice President of International Marketing Direct Reports: 0 Own the Northern Europe Marketing Function Act as a market expert, drawing from research, competitive intelligence, and customer insights to most effectively position the Axon promise across customer sets. Lead the development and execution of the marketing strategy for the Benelux (Netherlands, Belgium, Luxembourg) and the Nordics (Sweden, Norway, Finland, Denmark and Iceland) and adapt it to unique country needs and customer considerations. Increase awareness and shift perception in our core policing market, and create a pipeline to drive adoption of Axon’s growing product portfolio. Stay attuned to global public safety trends, regulatory developments, and local public affairs landscapes to inform marketing strategies. Partner with the revenue intelligence team to produce consumable reports that showcase performance, benchmark progress, and inform stakeholders about ongoing marketing efforts. Own overall market metrics including events ROI, ad and sponsorship ROS, lead progression, and pipeline influence. Public Relations & Public Affairs Work with our public affairs agencies to develop and execute key PR and public affairs campaigns, ensuring alignment with both global and local business objectives. Proactively manage Axon’s reputation and enhance brand visibility by responding to emerging issues, managing crises, and securing strategic media placements. Collaborate with the corporate communications team to ensure that messaging is consistent, timely, and relevant for both external audiences and internal stakeholders. Partner with government affairs teams to support advocacy efforts and policy initiatives, positioning Axon as a leader in the public safety industry. Plan and Execute Marketing Campaigns & Events Collaborate with our events and digital teams to plan, manage, and execute in-person, hybrid, and webinar events. Create and implement integrated marketing campaigns that include case studies, video content, digital campaigns, and public relations strategies. Manage regional brand presence, including in online channels (social, web) Drive new, creative approaches to reach key audiences and personas using various channels and content mediums. Depending on market needs, develop locally relevant marketing strategies or adapt existing, proven frameworks. Track ROI, engagement, and audience feedback to refine and optimize campaign and event strategies. Sales Enablement Provide strategic insights into Axon’s go-to-market motion and competitive positioning to create and progress opportunities. Create and deploy field-facing enablement assets, sales playbooks, and content that aligns with priority selling scenarios. Develop and execute strategies in partnership with the sales team to promote cross-sell and upsell opportunities. Manage Relationships Collaborate with agency partners to coordinate media outreach, co-marketing initiatives, and customer reference opportunities. Manage internal relationships to build cohesive product launch plans, adapt content for local markets, and support the sales team in achieving their goals. Foster strong ties with public relations, public affairs, and external communications teams to ensure a unified, impactful message across regions. What You Bring Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience 7+ years of marketing experience, ideally at a public safety, SaaS or technology company Experience developing and executing marketing strategies and managing external or in-house agencies Expertise in digital/growth marketing, events and public relations or public affairs Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to speak and write English fluently Experience working with customers in Northern Europe (Benelux, Nordics) Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work. Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve. Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions. Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment. review_candidates.title: MES Head
review_candidates.description: Role Description The MES Head is a full-time, on-site role based in Tirupati, responsible for leading the implementation, and continuous improvement of the Manufacturing Execution System across the facility. This role oversees daily MES operations, ensures accurate data flow between shop floor and enterprise systems, and supports production, quality, and maintenance teams with real-time information. The MES Head collaborates with cross-functional stakeholders to define requirements, configure workflows, and manage system upgrades and integrations. Typical responsibilities include monitoring system performance, resolving MES-related issues, maintaining documentation and standards, training users, and driving process automation and compliance. The role also involves analyzing operational metrics, recommending improvements, and aligning MES capabilities with business and regulatory needs. Qualifications Demonstrated expertise in Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), including system architecture, configuration, deployment, and support. Strong background in electronics or high-volume manufacturing environments, with knowledge of shop-floor processes, production planning, and quality control. Experience integrating MES with ERP, PLM, and automation platforms, and familiarity with data collection, traceability, and reporting tools. Proficiency in process mapping, workflow design, and continuous improvement methodologies (such as Lean, Six Sigma, or similar). Solid analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret operational data and convert it into actionable insights. Effective leadership and stakeholder management abilities, including team mentoring, cross-functional collaboration, and vendor coordination. Clear written and verbal communication skills, with the capacity to train users and create technical and process documentation. Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field; an advanced degree or relevant certifications in MES or manufacturing systems are an advantage. Willingness to work on-site in Tirupati and engage directly with production teams on the shop floor.
